Dark Chocolate Chia Pudding ( High Protein )
meal prep | under 350 calories | breakfast diaries | overnight recipe | sugar free 

Nutrition: 
C: 24 | F: 14 | P: 30
Calories: 314 per serve
Makes 2

Ingredients
1/4 cup chia seeds
2 cup milk, plant based, regular, lactose free you choose :) 
1.5  scoop chocolate flavoured protein powder 
1/2 tbsp cocoa powder
1/2 tsp vanilla extract
1 tbsp honey / maple syrup / monkfruit sweetener, adjust as per taste
1 tbsp greek yogurt, for topping + chocolate chips 

Method
add chia + protein powder + cocoa powder + milk + monkfruit to a bowl and mix together 
leave it on the counter for 20 minutes, stir again and then refridgerate (we do this so the chia doesnt clump up which allows max absorbtion overnight) 
in the morning, spoon into a glass or bowl and top with a tea spoon of greek yogurt and chocolate chips ( optional, not required) or if you really feel indulgent, melt 10-15 grams dark chocolate and make a shell
